image_description: A small, dark-colored turtle positioned on a rough, grey concrete or stone surface. The turtle has a high-domed, oval carapace that appears dark brown to black with a matte to slightly glossy texture. The head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small lateral eyes. The limbs are partially visible, appearing short and stout with dark, scaly skin. The plastron is mostly obscured by the angle and shadow, but the overall body shape suggests a compact build typical of mud turtles.
